desc:
Car crushers 2 is the perfect game when you feel like destroying stuff for fun! Smash cars in 59 different crushers, destroy supercars in Demolition Derby, survive the whole server getting nuked or race with friends. The game features more than 400 vehicles with content added regularly!

❤️ FREE Exclusive Car after 2 Million Likes!
⭐ Favorite & Join the group to access extra cars: https://www.roblox.com/My/Groups.aspx?gid=2726951
🛠️ BUILD TOOLS IN PRIVATE SERVERS (PC/Mobile only)

Update 91 Part 2 Changelog:
☠️ Added 3 New Cars
🧟 Halloween Invasion Event Server
🧛 3 New Monster Types (Vampire, Frankenstein, Realistic Zombie)
💥 Tank Shots, shredders & explosions can now damage monsters
🚗 10 Returned Cars in the Halloween Shop
💰 5 daily playtime rewards to the Halloween Shop
🎃 2 new rims & Unstoppable Marauder Title + Chat Color
🏁 Class D -> B now more common in Race Competitions

Genres: Physics Simulation, Car Destruction, Driving, Demolition Derby, Car Racing, Ragdoll Physics
